title: IStar's Filtered Hoppers
description: Take control of your item flow with Advanced Hoppers, featuring customizable item filtering.
body:
# **IStar's Filtered Hoppers**
**IStar's Filtered Hoppers** adds the Advanced Hopper, a significant upgrade that lets you precisely control item flow.

Key Features:

**Advanced Hopper**: A new hopper block with customizable item filtering.
![Advanced Hopper Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3fdfdaac24c8dbceaedc247c20653b51fae4634e.png)

## **Tiered Filters**:

### - **Iron Filter**: 5 item capacity.

![Iron Filter Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/73e1a5f5a650ca93a53baa603122683346cbc66b.png)

### - **Gold Filter**: 9 item capacity.

![Gold Filter Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2935c7b0c24e49c2e6e4ffcbd2da461be8a23c92.png)

### - **Diamond Filter**: 27 item capacity.

![Diamond Filter Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ffe0ee1c60a0962e553fa359739661bb90347189.png)

Easy Interface: Manage allowed items with a simple in-game GUI.
